title: ICAI CA January 2027 Correction Window Now Open!
content:
# ICAI CA January 2027 Correction Window Now Open!

Ek important update hai for all CA Foundation and Intermediate aspirants appearing for the January 2027 examinations. The Institute of Chartered Accountants of India (ICAI) ne exam forms mein corrections karne ke liye window open kar di hai.

The Correction Window is live, allowing candidates to make necessary amendments to their submitted examination forms. This is a crucial opportunity to ensure all your details are accurate.

*   **Correction Window Opens:** November 20, 2026 (10:00 AM IST)
*   **Correction Window Closes:** November 22, 2026 (11:59 PM IST)
*   **What you can correct:** Candidates can primarily make changes to their **examination city/centre** and the **medium of answer papers** (English/Hindi).

Please note, other personal particulars like name, date of birth, gender, or category are generally not editable through this window and require separate profile updates on the SSP portal with due approvals.

Is mauke ko miss mat kariye. Apne form ko ek baar acchi tarah se review kar lein aur agar koi correction hai toh time par kar lein.

## Read the Official Document
*   [Visit the ICAI e-Services Portal for Corrections](https://eservices.icai.org)

*Published on: 21 November 2026*
